notes.title: Battle Armor Division, the update 1.3.9 is ready:
notes.content:
Battle Armor Division 1.3.9
Hey Pilots, the update 1.3.9 is ready: 
We'll do our best to fix all the issues reported and update the game on regular basis. Thank you! 


- New graphics added, Gauge system.
- Menu, Gamepad compatibility, fixed.
- Analog stick, now you can move your B.A faster or slower.
- Game engine, updated.
- Achievement "Bullet Proof, finish a level, without suffering more than 10% of damage.
- Refreshing screen, optimized.
- Some minor glitch fixed.

notes.title: B.A.D Battle Armor Division - Update 1.3.7
notes.content:
August 28th, 2015

Update 1.3.7 – Patch Notes

- Rumble effect improved.
- First Mission, if you kill the Crab Tank "too early", now the mission end correctly.
- Menu option click precision. Fixed.
- Gamepad compatibility improved (shock wave 4, X-box one, and more)
- Pause Menu button loop: fixed.
- Now it's possible to config the keys from the Pause Menu.

We’ll continue to listen the community and give you the best experience with Battle Armor Division!

notes.title: B.A.D Battle Armor Division - Update 1.3.6
notes.content:
August 20th, 2015

Update 1.3.6 – Patch Notes

- Keyboard controls: keys for Anti-Ballistic Missiles and Smoke Grenades, now work correctly.
- Control Config Menu: when you click with the mouse on the pad, the selection appears late. Fixed.
- Time when you complete a mission, now it reset correctly.
- Clicking a menu option, sometimes it select the option above. Fixed.
- Training Missions, the exit menu now work correctly.
- Radar animation, now it fade correctly.


We’ll continue to listen the community and give you the best experience with Battle Armor Division!

notes.title: B.A.D Battle Armor Division - Update 1.3.5
notes.content:
Update 1.3.5 – Patch Notes

- General performance improved.
- Pause button, now work correctly.
- Debrifing screen, now end correctly.

We’ll continue to listen the community and give you the best experience with Battle Armor Division!
